facts.statement: Free Realms' first anniversary fell on April 29, 2010, and a birthday party was held in the game from the announcement until May 10, 2010.
facts.quote: Free Realms fêtera son premier anniversaire le 29 avril 2010

facts.statement: Birthday parties were set up in eight zones: Joyful Vale, Criqueville, Snow Hill, Misty Glade, Wugachug, Blackspore, Heather Moor and Sanctuary.
facts.quote: Il y a des fêtes d'anniversaire partout dans Free Realms.

article_summaries.title: Fête d'Anniversaire pour Free Realms!
article_summaries.summary: A French-language SOE news post announcing Free Realms' first-anniversary birthday party, running from the posting day until May 10, 2010, with party areas in eight zones, birthday quests from Camellia in Sanctuary, party items for sale, and a cake-collecting reward from the boss Gâtostein (Cakenstein in the English client). The exact posting date is not shown in the text (only 'Posted 1 year, 1 month ago' relative to the capture), so the date is left null.
